statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-26933 affects Packetbeat protocol parser components. The Filebeat image builds and ships Filebeat only, not Packetbeat, so the affected Packetbeat parser code is not present in the runtime image.

CVE-2026-26931 affects Metricbeat's Prometheus remote_write handler. The Filebeat image builds and ships Filebeat only, not Metricbeat, so the affected Metricbeat handler is not present in the runtime image.

CVE-2025-68383 affects the Filebeat Syslog parser and Libbeat Dissect processor and was fixed upstream in 8.19.9, 9.1.9, and 9.2.3 (affected ranges 8.0.0-8.19.8, 9.0.0-9.1.8, 9.2.0-9.2.2). The shipped versions 8.19.17, 8.19.18, 9.3.6, 9.3.7, and 9.4.3 are past those fixes and do not contain the vulnerable code. Docker Scout flags this against a broad (>=0) elastic/beats Go module PURL range, producing a false positive.
